author: Vobaseball12
body:
Hi there, as you can see, I'm looking for a team on here!

You can see my stats at my profile, but there isn't much there since I'm new.

You can see my "real" stats at OCN's website at my profile.

I play frontlines, can play defense if needed, and I am very good at cannoning.

I have TS, and a working mic.

I have experience with teams and tourneys, and I have played/am playing on a team on Ocn right now.

Reply here if interested!
